purpose: Condition on the exact Z9 native PM density and velocity, and infer only the 25 observation nuisance parameters. Determine whether the large Z9 curvature displacement persists when density/velocity reconstruction is removed.
goal_alignment: Diagnose the present-day density/velocity posterior before further model expansion. Final target remains LG-only 0.3 cMpc/h with 1-2 cMpc/h surroundings, followed by consistent IC and forward evolution. This diagnostic is still 12 cMpc/h and is not a recovered density map.

data.contract: Regenerate with the frozen Z9 loader, assert exact equality with saved Z9 mock arrays, then use the saved data. No new noise, no new PM, no real observed counts/velocities, no covariance refitting. Keep heldout counts and radial rows excluded from the likelihood.

model.free: All 25 standardized observation nuisance parameters: six normalizations, six biases, six FoG dispersions, two selection coefficients, four radial calibration coefficients, one common curvature. They retain their independent standard-normal priors; no nuisance fixed to generator truth.
model.interpretation: This is an oracle conditional diagnostic. It removes field freedom and the field prior together, so it cannot isolate the field prior alone or establish real-data calibration. Finite noisy mocks need not yield intervals containing every true parameter.

sampler.initialization: zero plus .5 independent standardized jitter; no optimized or generator-truth initialization

required: same original observation map and likelihood with only field degrees removed
finite-difference gradient and heldout exclusion checks
all 25 nuisance coordinates and log posterior convergence
physical curvature intervals compared with true values and Z9 free-field intervals
bias-curvature correlations and independent heldout prediction
assessment.decision: If curvature recovers here while Z9 free-field fits remain displaced, the discrepancy is linked to field inference/prior/coupling under this mock. If it persists, prioritize the conditional likelihood, nuisance identifiability or sampling. No automatic production promotion in either case.
assessment.stop: Two conditional fits, automatic aggregation, driver interpretation. No further bundle without user approval.
